description: Get multiple coin records by their coin IDs. Batch version of get_coin_record_by_name. Optionally filter by spent status and height range.

end_height.description: Only return coins created before this height

include_spent_coins.description: Include coins that have been spent (default: false)

names.description: Array of coin IDs to look up (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes hex each)

start_height.description: Only return coins created at or after this height

name: get_coin_records_by_names
